name: Global analysis and mathematical economics
summary: Topological and dynamical methods were applied to equilibrium existence and price adjustment.

name: Local Langlands for GL_n
to: representation theory of p-adic groups (local Langlands)
summary: Harris-Taylor and Henniart proved the local Langlands correspondence for GL_n through the cohomology of Shimura varieties.

name: Universality of rotational invariance at 2D criticality via coupling and integrability
to: scaling limits of planar critical models
summary: Rotational invariance at the critical point was proved across a broad class of planar models by coupling lattices with their rotations and using integrability inputs.

name: Concentration of measure
summary: Isoperimetric inequalities in high dimension give sharp deviation bounds for Lipschitz functions, used for Banach space geometry and probability in product spaces.

name: Fourier integral operators and microlocal analysis
summary: Fourier transforms and symplectic geometry of the cotangent bundle are combined to study singularities of solutions of linear PDE.

name: Real-variable methods in complex analysis (Hardy spaces)
summary: Real-variable characterisations of Hardy spaces and the duality of H^1 and BMO replace complex-variable methods in harmonic analysis.

name: NP-completeness
summary: Satisfiability was shown universal for NP, with many combinatorial problems reduced to it.

name: Random matrix statistics and the zeros of zeta
summary: The pair correlation of zeta zeros matches that of eigenvalues of random unitary matrices, suggesting a spectral interpretation of the zeros.

name: Higher algebraic K-theory
summary: Homotopy-theoretic constructions (plus construction, classifying spaces) define K-groups of rings in all degrees, importing topology into algebra and number theory.

name: Catastrophe theory
summary: Singularity classification was proposed as a model of discontinuous change in morphogenesis.
